value.title: Request and Response public surface of wave 3

acceptanceCriteria.text: `Request` is a public interface in `com.snoworca.naruserve` declaring `method()`, `path()`, `rawPath()`, `param(name)`, `query(name)`, `queries(name)`, `header(name)`, `headers(name)`, `remoteAddress()`, `isSecure()`, `lastEventId()`, `attribute(key, value)` and `attributeAs(key, type)`, with `method()` returning `Method`. [D-071] Decision: the write overload `attribute(String, @Nullable Object)` returns `void` and the read overload is generic `<T> @Nullable T attributeAs(String, Class<T>)`, so a literal `null` second argument unambiguously removes the attribute. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-1 SDS-AC-1]

`Response` is a public interface in `com.snoworca.naruserve` declaring `status(code)`, `header(name, value)`, `send(@Nullable Object)`, `html(String)`, `stream(InputStream, contentType)`, `end()`, `isCommitted()` and `abort(error)`. [D-071] Decision: `status` and `header` return the receiver; `send`, `html`, `stream`, `end` and `abort` return `void`. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-1 SDS-AC-2]

At the wave 3 merge, a reflection test finds no method named `body`, `form`, `file`, `files`, `parts`, `json`, `download`, `cache`, `sse`, `cookie`, `getCookies`, `addCookie`, `service` or `application` on `Request` or `Response`, even where the parameter and return types of such a method exist in wave 3; the later waves of D-392 add them. [D-392; wave decision: Request and response surface]

The public API package is JSpecify NullMarked. Nullable accessors and nullable parameters are annotated, including send(Object), JSON values, attribute write values and abort(error); typed attributeAs reads are nullable. A reflection test checks the current public surface.

A Kotlin source test compiles and runs calls to the wave 3 `Request` and `Response` methods, assigning `req.query("q")` to `String?` and `req.path()` to `String` without platform types. [D-072] Decision: the Kotlin test routes a request through the test-fixtures `TestApp` harness and calls every wave 3 `Request` and `Response` method from a Kotlin lambda. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-1 SDS-AC-4]

value.requirement: The system shall expose Request and Response interfaces using unambiguous attribute writes, attributeAs typed reads, removeAttribute, and one nullable Object send method with runtime text/byte/JSON/empty dispatch; all other existing request/response operations remain available.
value.rationale: Covers D-071, D-072, D-392 and the wave decision on the request and response surface (D-392 overrides D-071). Supports T01, T02, T03, T05, T06 and T07.
